basic_info.description: This charming and cozy two-bedroom home is a wonderful urban escape. A lovely garden provides a daily refuge to relax and a great spot to entertain. The flowing layout delivers views of the city or the garden from every room. The updated, bright and modern kitchen is perfect for making home-cooked meals, and the garage has ample room for storage or motorcycle and bicycle parking. A central location in the vibrant Excelsior District is close to transportation, restaurants, and shopping. Other recent improvements include solar panels, an on-demand water heater, Ductless Mini-Split A/C & heat and an updated bathroom. This is a special home that you've got to see.
